lines: (A capybara girl in a purple dress bounces over, her ponytail swinging.) Eee! Bramble said you'd come! Hi hi hi! I'm Melody!
{player}: Are you... a capybara?
Capybara AND pop star. Well, pop star in training. And I've just written a brand new song! It's called Tick Tock, Don't Stop. Well, it's called that today.
But I can't sing it for the very first time without my best friend Heather. She's out in the green meadow, grazing. Will you fetch her? Please please please?
Heather's in the green meadow! Horns, a scooter, and the biggest smile in the Void. You can't miss her.
You found her! Heather! Front row! OK. Deep breath. Ahem. This one's called Tick Tock, Don't Stop!
(Melody spins on her shiny Mary Janes and sings.) Tick tock, the clock goes round, my feet won't touch the ground!
(Heather whoops and stamps her hooves. A few little aliens stop to clap.)
Thank you, thank you! You're too kind! {player}, you're my first fan AND my best friend's second best friend. That's a lot of friend.
Oh! And Dash came by looking for you. He's waiting by the portal. Something about the stars?
(A capybara girl in a purple dress bounces over, her ponytail swinging.) Eee! A new face! Hi hi hi! I'm Melody!
{player}: Are you... a capybara?
Capybara AND pop star. Well, pop star in training. Everybody gets along with capybaras, did you know? Even crocodillos. It's my gift.
I sing at the Market every morning. Come and dance with me sometime!
(Melody's mid-show, twirling under the striped canopy while the footlights flash.) Thank you, thank you! You're too kind! Oh, it's YOU!
Come up on the stage! Groove with me, {groove}, right on the beat. Eight in a row and you get an encore!
{player}: Eight?!
You can do it! Listen for the boom-tss. Boom... tss... BOOM!
My very own stage! Bramble grew the flowers round it, Dash wired up the speakers, and Rex... well, Rex barked at it. Supportively.
Every evening, right here, right by my portal. So if I miss home, I can hear the springs singing through it.
Hop up and dance with me! Press {groove} on the beat.
{player}! My favourite backup dancer! Have you been grooving? Shoulders, hips, ponytail!
Come to my show tonight, by my portal on the lake shore. Six o'clock till nine. Front row seats for you!
(Melody's mid-song, spinning on her shiny Mary Janes.) ...and the stars all go YES, YES, YES! Oh, hi {player}!
That's my new song. It's called "Yes!" The whole thing is just happy words. Wanna be my backup dancer?
{player}: Maybe!
I'll take a maybe! Maybes are just yeses that are a little bit shy.
Dance break! Doctor's orders. Well, Bramble's orders. She says a good wiggle is good for your heart.
Wiggle with me! Shoulders, hips, ponytail. Ponytail is the most important part.
(She's singing scales to a row of very patient flowers.) La la LAAA. The flowers are my audience. They never leave early.
Sometimes I get nervous before I sing. So I breathe. In for four, out for four. Then I'm ready!
You can try it too, whenever your tummy feels fluttery.
Have you met Bramble? She pops right up out of the ground! I screamed SO loud.
Then we became best friends. I sing to her flowers and they grow twice as fast. Or maybe they're just dancing.
(Melody does an enormous capybara yawn.) Even pop stars need their beauty sleep.

rotate: Mm-hm. (She crosses her arms and narrows her eyes.) ...Sorry, just practising my sassy face. How was it?
Capybara fact! We love a warm bath. The Hot Springs are basically my second home.
Every song I write is about being happy. Even the sad ones. They're about being happy AGAIN.
